Name: Child Custody - Ex-Spouses Can Visit Children After Divorce
Author: MissAnaira
Description:
Ever wondered why after you divorce, your ex doesn't visit the kids? Look no further, for the Child Custody mod is here! NPCs you divorced can now visit your farmhouse on Sundays to spend as much time as they can on their visitation day. [u]PLEASE NOTE[/u]: [b]You must set the configuration in Generic Mod Config Menu in order for the mod to work! [/b]Supports up to 2 divorcees in case you have a child with 2 different NPCs. Must sleep at least one night in order to take effect if loading from an ongoing save.

[i]Expansion mods currently compatible:[/i]
1. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] (SVE)
2. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url] (RSV)
3. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url] (ES)
4. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8587]Downtown Zuzu[/url] (DTZ)
5. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13996]Return to Mineral Town[/url] (MT)
6. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9600]Lumisteria Visit Mount Vapius[/url] (VMV)
7. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22600]Passerby Cemetery[/url] (PC)
8. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11666]Stoffton[/url] (S)
